chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad reported to me, he said: Ahmad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, he said: al-Husayn ibn Nasr ibn Muzahim narrated to us, he said: my father narrated to me, he said: Abu Abd al-Rahman Abdullah ibn Abd al-Malik narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Salama, from his father Salama ibn Kuhayl, from Abu Sadiq who said: I heard the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) saying:

My religion is the religion of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, and my lineage is the lineage of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace. So whoever attacks my religion and my lineage has indeed attacked the religion and lineage of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace.

key_terms.تناول: Tanawala — to attack, disparage, speak ill of
key_terms.حسب: Hasab — noble descent, lineage, honor inherited through family
key_terms.دين: Din — religion, faith, the way of life one follows

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his religion and lineage in relation to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) declares that his faith and noble descent are identical to those of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW). This statement was made in the context of defending his religious authority and familial connection to the Prophet, emphasizing that any disparagement of his religion or lineage is a direct assault on the Prophet’s own religion and lineage.
